title: Implement TLS for NNTP listener in reader daemon
description:
Add TLS support to the reader daemon's NNTP listener using rustls. Config: [tls] cert_file, key_file (PEM). When configured, also support STARTTLS upgrade on the plaintext port. When not configured, STARTTLS capability is omitted from CAPABILITIES. Minimum TLS version: 1.2. Artifact: reader/src/tls.rs.

Acceptance:
- TLS listener accepts connections from openssl s_client without error
- STARTTLS upgrade on plaintext port works with openssl s_client -starttls nntp
- TLS 1.1 and below rejected (verify with sslyze or openssl)
- Certificate load failure at startup exits with clear error naming the file
- Slrn connects over TLS to the reader without modification
